name: reading-pack
title_zh: 把读过的书变成可检索的个人思想库
tagline_zh: 读时划线、读后即忘？每次想引用都翻不到原文。这个 skill 把摘录、批注和你的联想自动归档成可对话的阅读日记。
tagline_en: Stop losing your highlights. Turn every book's margin notes, quotes, and your own reactions into a searchable.
why_zh: 不是简单存笔记——它按「原文-你的话-触发情境」三层结构重组摘录，让旧书在需要时自己跳出来。
why_en: It doesn't just store notes—it restructures them into quote→reaction→context triads, so past books resurface when you need them.
limit_zh: 只处理你手动喂入的文本摘录，不扫描 PDF/EPUB 原文；不生成书评或思维导图，产物止步于结构化日记。
limit_en: Only handles text you paste in—no PDF/EPUB scanning. Output stops at structured diary entries, no summaries or mind maps. Slows down past 500 entries.
